# Integra Markets

> Commodity news sentiment with the evidence attached. Every score names the
> rule that produced it and quotes the words from the article, so it can be
> checked rather than believed.

Integra scores news coverage for commodity markets — energy, metals,
agriculture — and for the macro subjects those markets transmit through
(interest rates, inflation, dollar strength). Coverage is continuous from 2020
across 49 subjects.

## What makes the output unusual

- **Named signals, quoted evidence.** A reading is not a bare number. It carries
  the rule that fired ("Chokepoint disruption", "Exchange stock draw", "Demand
  support") bound to the span of source text that triggered it.
- **Sample size on every figure.** An aggregate always reports how many articles
  it was computed from. A score on three articles and a score on nine hundred
  are not the same claim, and are not presented as if they were.
- **Archive extent is reported regardless of plan.** A response says how far the
  archive reaches even when the caller's plan cannot read that far.

## Interfaces

- REST API: https://api.integramarkets.app — bearer token, no SDK required.
  OpenAPI: https://api.integramarkets.app/openapi.json
- MCP connector: https://mcp.integramarkets.app/mcp — works in Claude on web,
  desktop and mobile. Seven tools over the same data as the REST surface.
- Console: https://dashboard.integramarkets.app

## Accuracy and limits

- Sentiment classification scores 71.4% on the Financial Phrasebank benchmark.
- Scores are signed, -1 to +1, 0 neutral. `confidence` is a separate magnitude
  and is NOT directional.
- Scoring is applied retroactively over the archive, with the model name,
  version and scoring timestamp recorded per row. `published_at` is the genuine
  publication time, so there is no look-ahead in the content — but the model is
  applied with hindsight, and anyone backtesting should know that.
- Evidence density is not stationary: roughly 30% of articles in the last 30
  days carry a named signal, against 15% across the deep archive.

## Not available

- There is no SDK. The API is plain HTTP; generate a client from the OpenAPI
  spec if you want one.
- Historical analog matching (`/v1/historical/analogs`) returns 501 pending an
  archive backfill.
- Divergence and threshold event webhooks do not exist. Quota-threshold
  webhooks do.
